'''L2-PN''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was stationed aboard the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']] where it contacted a Republic strike team prior to the beginning of their mission to [[Taral V]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
L2-PN serves as the quest giver for Republic players for Flashpoint: Taral V in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
